name: Chenille
description: Caterpillar cord — a run of pile beads threaded along a core.

code.style: --rule: ( --rot: @pick(0deg, 45deg, 90deg, 135deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 44%; width: 100%; height: 12%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 28%; width: 100%; height: 44%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, #000 92%, transparent 92%) 0 0 / 25% 100%; mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, #000 92%, transparent 92%) 0 0 / 25% 100%; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } -webkit-transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
